templateOptions.label: BaseUrl
templateOptions.description: The URL to the API. Typically, this will be https://api.nmbrsapp.com/api

templateOptions.label: Token URL
templateOptions.description: The URL to obtain the API token. Typically, this will be https://identityservice.nmbrs.com/connect/token

templateOptions.label: Token Host DNS Name
templateOptions.description: The dns name of the host to obtain the API token. Typically, this will be identityservice.nmbrs.com

templateOptions.label: Client ID
templateOptions.description: The client ID to connect to the API.

templateOptions.label: Client secret
templateOptions.description: The client secret to connect to the API

templateOptions.label: Subscription Key
templateOptions.description: The subscription key to connect to the API.

templateOptions.label: Initial RefreshToken
templateOptions.description: The initial refresh token to connect to the API, which will be used to obtain access tokens and consecutive refresh tokens.

templateOptions.label: Refresh Token Save File
templateOptions.description: The file path to the file where the refresh token will be saved.

templateOptions.label: CompanyName
templateOptions.description: The companyNames for which the employees will be imported

templateOptions.label: DebtorName
templateOptions.description: The DebtorName for which the departments will be imported

templateOptions.label: End date threshold
templateOptions.description: The amount of days a contract must be in the past before being excluded from the imported data

templateOptions.label: Toggle debug logging
templateOptions.description: When toggled, debug logging will be displayed
